purpose: Round 5 Lane D — legacy batch 2, chosen by the FIVE failure classes the Founder named (§9): Math/high-formula · two-column · Vietnamese text · Science · History/Geography, plus the one class where round 4 measured the NEW pipeline as WORSE than the old product (lesson attachment at the tail of a book). History/Geography has never been measured on either side; Toán 4 tập một is the largest untouched book in scope; the TV5 lesson is a POEM, which is the direct regression on the verse-flattening defect the round-4 colour-veto fix uncovered.
rules: reprocess from the ORIGINAL SOURCE (PDF page + Apple-Vision OCR lines), never from the old units or packs
REPROCESSED != TRUSTED and RESTORED != TRUSTED — the new output is a candidate until independently audited; eligible-for-teaching stays 0 until Founder thresholds
pages the pipeline cannot process are WITHHELD, never guessed
nothing in poc-out/ outside poc-out/round5/legacy/ is written; the round-4 batches and the old outputs stay side by side
no manual prettifying of any output on either side

lessons.title: Thăng Long - Hà Nội
lessons.why: HISTORY/GEOGRAPHY — the failure class round 4 never measured on either side. Four of five pages are two-column, with a table and two diagrams. The OLD product served exactly ONE block for this lesson (a suSources excerpt): the old surface is almost empty, so this batch measures what the pipeline PRODUCES where the product had nothing, not a rescue.

lessons.title: Triều Lý và việc định đô ở Thăng Long
lessons.why: HISTORY/GEOGRAPHY, prose-heavy (8 of 10 pages single-column) — the shape Lane C's `prose-dated-events-v1` hypothesis is about, measured here only as extraction fidelity, never as a timeline claim. Again ONE OLD served block (suSources).

lessons.title: Gió, bão và phòng chống bão
lessons.why: SCIENCE / figure-caption — the class batch 1 could not measure (only 2 caption blocks fell in its stratified sample; §5a had to draw a quota sample inside a single lesson). Three of four pages carry diagrams. The OLD side is 2 khoaExperiments activities, the family round 3 found serving figure labels as experiment steps.

lessons.title: Khúc xạ ánh sáng
lessons.why: SCIENCE at the high-formula end, and an untouched grade: 3 formula pages, 2 tables, 4 of 5 pages two-column. Physics notation (angles, indices, ratios) exercises the number/unit guards on text that is not arithmetic. OLD = 3 khoaExperiments activities.

lessons.title: Ôn tập chung
lessons.why: MATH/HIGH-FORMULA in the largest untouched book in scope (37 lessons, none reprocessed), AND the attachment class where round 4 measured the NEW pipeline as WORSE than the old product. This is the LAST lesson of the book and the run deliberately includes the book's tail (pdf 132-134, beyond the pages that carry units) so the imprint/back-cover attachment defect — which survived both round-4 builds on Toán 4 tập hai Bài 73 — is exercised on a different book. OLD = 29 units / 29 sam-units rows, no pack activity.

lessons.title: Đọc: Tiếng hạt nảy mầm
lessons.why: VIETNAMESE TEXT — and the regression on the defect the round-4 colour-veto fix uncovered: this is a POEM on a colour-heavy page, the exact shape where tc2-p2 served five verse lines joined into a single prose run (batch-1 report §7.4). OLD = 1 tvReadings activity + 18 units + 18 sam-units rows, so both sides have a real surface here.
